sources.entry: Software Optimization Guide for the AMD Zen5 Microarchitecture - Where AMD states when the op cache feeds micro-ops, and the fusion and alignment rules for hot loops.

summary.title: Software Optimization Guide for the AMD Zen5 Microarchitecture (PUB) (58455pub)
summary.one_liner: AMD's official Zen 5 software optimization guide, which covers microarchitecture details relevant to tuning code for this CPU core.
keywords: how to optimize code for zen 5
takeaways: This is AMD's official Software Optimization Guide for the Zen 5 microarchitecture, document 58455pub, revision 1.00, released 2024-08-15.
The guide is the primary source for how the Zen 5 front end fetches and decodes instructions, including op cache behavior.
It is the reference to consult for fusion and alignment rules that affect hot loop performance.
The cached page text is mostly portal navigation and cookie notices; the technical content itself was not included in the fetched text.
summary.summary: This is the landing page on AMD's Technical Information Portal for the Software Optimization Guide for the AMD Zen 5 Microarchitecture (document 58455pub, revision 1.00, English, dated 2024-08-15). The fetched text contains only portal chrome and cookie-consent boilerplate, so the actual guide content (op cache feed rules, fusion and alignment rules) is not visible here and is described only from the listing note. The page is best used as a pointer to the official PDF/document for Zen 5 low-level tuning.
